title: Electromagnetic Induction
definition: The phenomenon where a changing magnetic field through a conductor induces an electromotive force (EMF) or electric current, governed primarily by Faraday's Laws of Induction.
importanceInUpsc: Fundamental to understanding power generation (generators, transformers), wireless charging, and modern electrical infrastructure, frequently appearing in Science & Tech Prelims.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Electromagnetic Induction.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Magnetism and Electricity
